title: Load balancing · per replica
description: A3: HTTP (GET /devices/{device_id}) and gRPC (GetDevice) through Envoy, per replica A/B/C: rate, share, active requests, p50/p95 (1m window), errors by status, and Envoy's own view. Replicas and Envoy are scraped directly (jobs sensor-app, envoy).

panels.title: Share of traffic per replica (last minute)
HTTP share per replica · GET /devices/{device_id} (last 1m)
panels.description: Fraction of HTTP test requests (GET /devices/{device_id}) each replica handled over the last minute, counted by the replica itself: sum by (replica) (rate(requests[1m])) / sum(rate(requests[1m])). Equal round robin should give about 33 % each; A-only gives A 100 %; weights 2:1:1 give 50/25/25.

panels.title: gRPC share per replica · GetDevice (last 1m)
panels.description: Fraction of gRPC test requests (GetDevice) each replica handled over the last minute, counted by the replica itself: sum by (replica) (rate(requests[1m])) / sum(rate(requests[1m])). Equal round robin should give about 33 % each; A-only gives A 100 %; weights 2:1:1 give 50/25/25.

panels.title: HTTP request rate per replica
panels.description: Requests per second each replica handled for GET /devices/{device_id}: sum by (replica) (rate(...[1m])). Counted by the replica (scraped directly, job sensor-app), not by Envoy. 'total' is the sum, i.e. the offered load that got through.

panels.title: HTTP share of total traffic per replica
panels.description: Each replica's fraction of all HTTP test requests over a 1-minute window. Dashed line: 1/3, the equal share expected under equal round robin. Under A-only, A is at 100 % and B, C have no series.

panels.title: HTTP active requests per replica
panels.description: Requests in flight on each replica. Solid: mean concurrency over 1m by Little's law, rate(sensor_http_request_duration_seconds_sum[1m]) (seconds of work per second = average number in flight). Dotted: the in-progress gauge as sampled at each 5 s scrape (instantaneous; it counts every route, including the /metrics scrape that reads it, so it never shows below 1).

panels.title: HTTP response time p50 / p95 per replica (window 1m)
panels.description: Server-side duration percentiles per replica over a 1-minute window: histogram_quantile(q, sum by (replica, le) (rate(sensor_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[1m]))). Measured inside the replica, so it excludes Envoy and the network; the client p95 in the results table includes both. Interpolated inside buckets (app/metrics.py LATENCY_BUCKETS).

panels.title: HTTP errors by status per replica
panels.description: Failed GET /devices/{device_id} requests per second, per replica and status (status_code !~2..), as counted by the replica. Dashed: failures that never reached a replica, counted by Envoy (requests failed because their upstream connection failed, e.g. sent to B after it stopped and before the health checks removed it, plus upstream timeouts). Envoy answers them with 503. Empty when nothing fails.

panels.title: gRPC request rate per replica
panels.description: Requests per second each replica handled for GetDevice: sum by (replica) (rate(...[1m])). Counted by the replica (scraped directly, job sensor-app), not by Envoy. 'total' is the sum, i.e. the offered load that got through.

panels.title: gRPC share of total traffic per replica
panels.description: Each replica's fraction of all gRPC test requests over a 1-minute window. Dashed line: 1/3, the equal share expected under equal round robin. Under A-only, A is at 100 % and B, C have no series.

panels.title: gRPC active requests per replica
panels.description: Requests in flight on each replica. Solid: mean concurrency over 1m by Little's law, rate(sensor_grpc_request_duration_seconds_sum[1m]) (seconds of work per second = average number in flight). Dotted: the in-progress gauge as sampled at each 5 s scrape (instantaneous).

panels.title: gRPC response time p50 / p95 per replica (window 1m)
panels.description: Server-side duration percentiles per replica over a 1-minute window: histogram_quantile(q, sum by (replica, le) (rate(sensor_grpc_request_duration_seconds_bucket[1m]))). Measured inside the replica, so it excludes Envoy and the network; the client p95 in the results table includes both. Interpolated inside buckets (app/metrics.py LATENCY_BUCKETS).

panels.title: gRPC errors by status per replica
panels.description: Failed GetDevice requests per second, per replica and status (code !=OK), as counted by the replica. Dashed: failures that never reached a replica, counted by Envoy (requests failed because their upstream connection failed, e.g. sent to B after it stopped and before the health checks removed it, plus upstream timeouts). Envoy answers them with UNAVAILABLE (HTTP 200, so no 5xx). Not cx_connect_fail: over HTTP/2 many calls wait on one connection attempt. Empty when nothing fails.

panels.title: Envoy: the proxy's own view (job envoy)
Requests per endpoint as Envoy sees them
panels.description: Upstream requests per second Envoy sent to each endpoint (per-endpoint stats; hostname = replica letter set in the cluster files). Should match the replicas' own rates above; a gap means requests Envoy sent that never got an answer.

panels.title: Healthy endpoints per cluster (active health checks)
panels.description: envoy_cluster_membership_healthy: how many endpoints of each cluster pass active health checks (interval 2 s, timeout 1 s, unhealthy after 2 failures, healthy after 2 successes). Drops when B is stopped, rises again after it restarts.

panels.title: Health-check failures and connect failures
panels.description: Per second: failed active health checks per cluster, and failed upstream TCP connections per endpoint (a request sent to a stopped replica before the health checks remove it).
